_warm_clones: Released clones kept warm (reset to origin/main) for the next item instead of deleted and re-cloned at 3.6 GB each; counted in the pool cap (run_store.py through clone_park.py, DISK_CHURN_MEASURE_CLONES_EAT_THE_VHDX).

_live: The live tier's proof rules (proof_lint.live_rules over proof_lint.DEFAULTS). flyer_re refuses any run naming flight (standing ruling). forbid_re refuses a proof that would load, restart, swap or mutate the game. Seconds: proof_max_s for the proof, plan_max_s for deploy_custom_mods.py's plan, gate_plan_max_s for a gate's plan.
_circling: RW2, circling.py. Thresholds unmeasured: replay real runs before trusting one. stop stays false until circling_replay.json, written by `circling.py replay --write` from hand-labelled runs on this code and these numbers, shows wrongful stops under false_stop_limit; the flag alone stops nothing.
_walls: What a checker mode may not see (checker_box.profile, read by item_exam.py). enforce false changes no launch.
